title: Executive operational report generation (PDF)
description: Generates a comprehensive, executive-ready operational report consolidating key metrics across cost, security, compliance, and availability into a single formatted document (PDF or HTML). Combines data from multiple sources — Cost Management, Defender for Cloud, Resource Health, alert history, and policy compliance — into a structured narrative with charts, tables, and recommendations that can be shared with leadership without further editing.
example_prompt: "Generate a monthly executive operational report for management group 'Production' covering the last 30 days. Include sections for: (1) Cost summary — total spend, MoM change, top 5 cost drivers, anomalies detected, (2) Security posture — Defender secure score trend, new high-severity findings, (3) Availability — resource health summary, SLA breaches, top 5 incidents by duration, (4) Compliance — policy compliance %, top non-compliant policies, (5) Operational hygiene — orphaned resources count and cost, stale RBAC assignments found, alert noise ratio. Format as a structured PDF-ready report with an executive summary, key metrics dashboard table, and per-section details with recommendations."
